title: jmespath: fix filter projection parsing
notes: A one-line precedence fix, with a compliance test, that broke another filter expression. The story is only the commit message.

defects.summary: Giving filters the same binding power as '*' breaks a filter that follows a star projection: reservations[*].instances[?bar==`1`] returns [] instead of the matching instances.
defects.trigger: a filter expression applied after a [*] projection, e.g. reservations[*].instances[?bar==`1`]
defects.caught_if: a condition evaluates a filter after a [*] projection (not only after [] or at the top level) and checks the matching elements are returned
defects.observed: at 7d46116 the expression returned []; at its parent it returned [[{'foo': 2, 'bar': 1}]]
